# Contract: files init generates

Formats of every file `tools/init` creates or proposes (R7 to R10, R14, R15 of [research.md](../research.md)). Every file is created only when absent. Values cite evidence; unknowns read `TO CONFIRM` or are commented and marked `inferred`. No shipped template names a project (FR-022).

## `ballast.toml`

Rendered by code; strings TOML-escaped; parsed back with `tomllib` and checked with the launcher's `pinned_ref` before the write. Tables without content are omitted.

```toml
# Generated by `ballast init`. Review it, then run `ballast trust`.
[standard]
ref = "vX.Y.Z"

[checks]
commands = [
  "pytest",  # evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:23
  # "make check",  # inferred from Makefile:12; confirm, then uncomment
]
timeout_minutes = 30

# Headless agents may run only what this allowlist names. Inferred from the
# checks above; confirm, then uncomment.
# [agents.permissions]
# extra_allow = [
#   "Bash(pytest*)",
# ]

[github]
repository = "OWNER/REPO"  # evidence: git remote origin
```

With no GitHub `origin`, `[github]` is replaced by a comment: `# [github] repository = "OWNER/REPO"  # no GitHub origin found; set it for intake and Draft PRs`. With no direct check, `[checks]` holds only commented inferred lines and no `commands` key is active.

## `.gitignore`

The exact `GITIGNORE` block of the same version's `tools/setup`: the whole file when absent, appended once when the probes fail and the block text is missing (R8).

## `.specify/memory/constitution.md`

From `templates/init/constitution.md`, placeholders `{{description}}`, `{{description_source}}`, `{{stack}}`, `{{stack_source}}`, `{{gates}}`, `{{date}}` (the ratification date line only). Sections: Core principles (generic: project-owned files and installed files; specs and ADRs govern intent; executable evidence before acceptance; no secrets or local destinations in tracked files; Ballast's protected inputs and operator-only trust), Product (`{{description}}` with its source or `TO CONFIRM`), Stack and gates (`{{stack}}`, `{{gates}}` with evidence), Governance and Amendment history. Setup keeps it because it exists.

## `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`

Only when neither exists. `AGENTS.md` is `templates/AGENTS.md` with the starter paragraph removed and each placeholder replaced:

| Placeholder | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `[PROJECT NAME]` | directory name of the root (structural, not evidence of intent) |
| `[WHAT THIS PROJECT DOES]` | description with its source, or `TO CONFIRM: what this project does` |
| `[WHERE THE APPLICATION, MIGRATIONS, CLIENTS AND TESTS LIVE]` | `TO CONFIRM: layout` |
| `[ACCEPTED ARCHITECTURE DOCUMENT]`, `[ADR DIRECTORY]`, `[GLOSSARY PATH]` | detected path (cited) or `TO CONFIRM` |
| `[LOCKED DEPENDENCY INSTALL COMMANDS]` | inferred from the lockfile (marked), or `TO CONFIRM` |
| `[COMMAND]` (fast and full gate) | active checks joined (cited), or `TO CONFIRM` |
| `[PROJECT INVARIANTS, OR A POINTER TO \`.specify/memory/constitution.md\`]` | pointer to the constitution |
| `[PROJECT R2 BOUNDARIES; see \`docs/policies/workflow.md\`]` | `TO CONFIRM: project R2 boundaries; see \`docs/policies/workflow.md\`` |
| `[RELEASE OR COMMIT-TITLE CONVENTION]`, `[PROCESS OR LINK]` | `TO CONFIRM` |

A test fails when the template gains a placeholder the table does not cover. `CLAUDE.md` is a relative symbolic link to `AGENTS.md`.

## `docs/policies/project/testing.md`

Only when absent and at least one direct check exists (AC-027). From `templates/init/testing.md`: the project's gates as a list of commands with their evidence, and inferred ones marked. No other addendum is generated.

## `.ballast/init/proposed.patch`

Unified diff, `a/`/`b/` prefixes, `git apply`-able, files in path order. Possible hunks:

- `AGENTS.md` (or the only, non-link `CLAUDE.md`): append `templates/init/agents-section.md` when the file has no link to `docs/policies/spec-kit-workflow.md`;
- `ballast.toml` on a rerun: append an absent `[checks]` or `[github]` table, or commented `# ballast init found: ...` lines for differing evidence (R14);
- a repository `.gitignore` whose rule un-ignores an installed path: comment out that line with `# ballast init: un-ignores PATH:` before it (R8).

## Not written

`templates/github/*` (PR template, Dependabot, PR-title workflow) and stack CI are never written; the report lists them with how to add them (FR-017).
